question: Find all actors who acted in more than 3 movies
correct_cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, count(m) AS movie_count WHERE movie_count > 3 RETURN a.name
generated_cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m) as num_movies WHERE num_movies > 3 RETURN p.name

question: Find actors and how many distinct movies they acted in
correct_cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN a.name, count(DISTINCT m) AS movie_count
generated_cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS num_movies WHERE num_movies > 1 RETURN p.name, num_movies

question: Find movies that have more than 3 actors
correct_cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) WITH m, count(a) AS actor_count WHERE actor_count > 3 RETURN m.title
generated_cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH m, COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS num_actors WHERE num_actors > 3 RETURN m
